I will also spread manure that I have gathered from my animals because it keeps the soil soft and helps the roots swell, and I am planting local cuttings from my last harvest since improved tuber seeds are hard to find and costly in our markets. I will not spray any chemicals or irrigate because root crops here do well with the rains from April to October, and since this plot is only 0.09 hectares, my family can manage all the planting, weeding, and harvesting without hiring anyone.
